```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```
# Prepare estimates
## Diversity, divergence
```{r}
pi_all <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/001_figure_with_all_estimates/diversity_divergence.csv")
correspondance_chromosomes <-  read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/001_figure_with_all_estimates/correspondance_thal_lyr_chromosomes.csv")
centromeres <- read.csv2('/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/centr_boundaries_wlodzimierz2023.txt',header=T, sep="\t")
centromeres$start <- as.numeric(centromeres$start)
centromeres$stop <-as.numeric(centromeres$stop)
centromeres <- centromeres %>% mutate(chromosome = paste0("Chr", chrom))
```
## Gene density 
```{r}
genes_thal <- correspondance_chromosomes %>%
  transmute(chromosome = chr_thal,
            gene_pos   = (star_thal + end_thal) / 2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chromosome), !is.na(gene_pos))

# get unique windows from pi_all
windows <- pi_all %>%
  dplyr::select(chromosome, window_start, window_end) %>%
  distinct()

# count genes per window (many-to-many join, then filter to in-window)
gene_density <- windows %>%
  left_join(genes_thal,
            join_by(chromosome,
                    window_start <= gene_pos,
                    window_end   >= gene_pos)) %>%
  group_by(chromosome, window_start, window_end) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_genes = sum(!is.na(gene_pos)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(gene_density = n_genes / 500000 * 1e6)

write.csv2(gene_density, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/gene_density/gene_density_tair10.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
## TE density
```{r}
te_annotation <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_Transposable_Elements.txt", header = T)
## Calculate density
te_thal <- te_annotation %>%
  transmute(
    chromosome = paste0("Chr", sub("^AT(\\d)TE.*", "\\1", Transposon_Name)),
    te_pos     = (Transposon_min_Start + Transposon_max_End) / 2
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(te_pos), grepl("^Chr\\d$", chromosome))

# same windows as pi_all / gene_density
te_density <- windows %>%
  left_join(te_thal,
            join_by(chromosome,
                    window_start <= te_pos,
                    window_end   >= te_pos)) %>%
  group_by(chromosome, window_start, window_end) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_tes = sum(!is.na(te_pos)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(te_density = n_tes / 500000 * 1e6)

write.csv2(te_density, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/te_density/te_density_tair10.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

## Centromeres correspondance
```{r}
centromeres_lyrata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/mn47/centr_boundaries_wlodzimierz_2023.txt", header=T)
```
## Find corresponding position in A. thaliana to the centromere in lyrata
```{r}
## Get centromere midpoint
library(dplyr)

centromeres_lyrata <- centromeres_lyrata %>%
  mutate(centr_mid = (centr_start + centr_end) / 2)

centromeres_thal_corresponding <- correspondance_chromosomes %>%
  left_join(centromeres_lyrata, by = c("lyrata_chr" = "Chr")) %>%
  mutate(lyr_mid = (lyrata_start + lyrata_end) / 2,
         dist    = abs(lyr_mid - centr_mid)) %>%
  group_by(lyrata_chr) %>%
  slice_min(dist, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    chromosome = chr_thal,
    thal_mid   = (star_thal + end_thal) / 2,
    span_start = thal_mid - 1e6,
    span_end   = thal_mid + 1e6,
    lyr_chr    = lyrata_chr
  )




write.csv2(centromeres_thal_corresponding, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/centromeres_lyrata_thaliana_corresponding.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

## Plot diversity 
```{r}
pi_all <- pi_all %>%
  left_join(centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, start, stop), by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(region = case_when(
    window_start < (start ) ~ "left",
    window_start > (stop  ) ~ "right",
    TRUE                            ~ "centromere")) 
```
## Calculate median pi
```{r}
pi_all <- pi_all %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  mutate(
    med_pi = median(avg_pi_window_thaliana, na.rm = TRUE),
    above  = ifelse(avg_pi_window_thaliana > med_pi, avg_pi_window_thaliana, med_pi)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```
## Diversity plot 
```{r}
diversity <- ggplot(pi_all, aes(x = window_start / 1e6, y = avg_pi_window_thaliana)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pi_all %>% filter(region != "centromere"),
              aes(ymin = med_pi, ymax = above, group = region),
              fill = "#7f3b08", alpha = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = pi_all %>% filter(region == "left"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, color = "#7f3b08", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = pi_all %>% filter(region == "right"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, color = "#7f3b08", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(data = pi_all %>% filter(region != "centromere"),
             size = 0.4, alpha = 0.4, na.rm = TRUE, color = "#7f3b08") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_pi), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres,
            aes(xmin = (start - 250000) / 1e6, xmax = (stop + 250000) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres_thal_corresponding %>% filter(chromosome == "Chr1"),
            aes(xmin = span_start / 1e6, xmax = span_end / 1e6),
            ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            fill = "#352F44", alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = expression(pi["4-fold"])) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())


ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/pi_all_chromosomes_with_ancestr_centromeres.png",
       plot = diversity,
       width = 300, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```

## Prepare diversity track

## Calculate median pi
```{r}
pi_all <- pi_all %>%

  mutate(
    med_pi = median(avg_pi_window_thaliana, na.rm = TRUE),

  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```
```{r}
## Read centromeres lyrata 
centromeres_lyrata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/mn47/centr_boundaries_wlodzimierz_2023.txt", header=T)
```
## Find corresponding position in A. thaliana to the centromere in lyrata
```{r}
# Get centromere midpoint
centromeres_lyrata$centr_mid <- (centromeres_lyrata$centr_start + centromeres_lyrata$centr_end) / 2
merged <- correspondance_chromosomes %>%
  left_join(centromeres_lyrata, by = c("lyrata_chr" = "Chr"))

merged <- merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dist_to_centromere = case_when(
      is.na(centr_start) ~ NA_real_,
      # overlapping
      lyrata_end >= centr_start & lyrata_start <= centr_end ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ pmin(
        abs(lyrata_start - centr_end),
        abs(lyrata_end   - centr_start),
        abs(lyrata_start - centr_start),
        abs(lyrata_end   - centr_end)
      )
    ),
    # nearest lyrata coordinate 
    nearest_lyrata_pos = ifelse(
      abs(lyrata_start - centr_mid) < abs(lyrata_end - centr_mid),
      lyrata_start,
      lyrata_end
    )
  )

# Find nearest position
nearest_per_centromere <- merged %>%
  group_by(lyrata_chr) %>%
  slice_min(dist_to_centromere, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(lyrata_chr, centr_start, centr_end, centr_mid,
         nearest_lyrata_pos, dist_to_centromere,
         thaliana_id, lyrata_id, lyrata_start, lyrata_end,star_thal, chr_thal)

# Get corresponding centromere
centromeres_thal_corresponding <- nearest_per_centromere %>%
  transmute(
    chromosome = chr_thal,     # must match facet_wrap(~ chromosome)
    thal_pos   = star_thal
  )
```

## Add gene density 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
# get gene positions on thaliana 
genes_thal <- correspondance_chromosomes %>%
  transmute(chromosome = chr_thal,
            gene_pos   = (star_thal + end_thal) / 2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chromosome), !is.na(gene_pos))

# get unique windows from pi_all
windows <- pi_all %>%
  dplyr::select(chromosome, window_start, window_end) %>%
  distinct()

# count genes per window (many-to-many join, then filter to in-window)
gene_density <- windows %>%
  left_join(genes_thal, by = "chromosome", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(gene_pos >= window_start, gene_pos <= window_end) %>%
  group_by(chromosome, window_start, window_end) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  right_join(windows, by = c("chromosome","window_start","window_end")) %>%
  mutate(n_genes = tidyr::replace_na(n_genes, 0),
         gene_density = n_genes / 500000 * 1e6)
## Add gene density column
pi_all <- pi_all %>%
  left_join(
    gene_density %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, window_start, window_end, gene_density),
    by = c("chromosome","window_start","window_end")
  )

# median line (mirror how you made med_dxy) — global or per whatever grouping you used
pi_all <- pi_all %>% group_by(chromosome)%>%
  mutate(med_dens = median(gene_density, na.rm = TRUE),
         above_dens = gene_density)   # <-- replace with the same rule you used for `above`
```

## Add TE density (TAIR10)
```{r}
te_annotation <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_Transposable_Elements.txt", header = T)
```
## Join TE annotation
```{r}
# TE positions on thaliana, chromosome parsed from the name (base R)
te_thal <- te_annotation %>%
  transmute(
    chromosome = paste0("Chr", sub("^AT(\\d)TE.*", "\\1", Transposon_Name)),
    te_pos     = (Transposon_min_Start + Transposon_max_End) / 2
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(te_pos), grepl("^Chr\\d$", chromosome))

# same windows as pi_all / gene_density
te_density <- windows %>%
  left_join(te_thal, by = "chromosome", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(te_pos >= window_start, te_pos <= window_end) %>%
  group_by(chromosome, window_start, window_end) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_te = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  right_join(windows, by = c("chromosome","window_start","window_end")) %>%
  mutate(n_te = tidyr::replace_na(n_te, 0),
         te_density = n_te / 500000 * 1e6)   # TEs per Mb

# join into pi_all on the same grid
pi_all <- pi_all %>%
  left_join(te_density %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, window_start, window_end, te_density),
            by = c("chromosome","window_start","window_end"))

pi_all <- pi_all %>%
  mutate(med_te   = median(te_density, na.rm = TRUE),
         above_te = te_density)   # same rule you used for above_dens

te_dens_plot <- ggplot(pi_all, aes(x = window_start / 1e6, y = te_density)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pi_all %>% filter(region != "centromere"),
              aes(ymin = med_te,
                  ymax = pmax(above_te, med_te),
                  group = region),
              fill = "#7B5EA7", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = pi_all %>% filter(region == "left"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, color = "#7B5EA7", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = pi_all %>% filter(region == "right"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, color = "#7B5EA7", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(data = pi_all %>% filter(region != "centromere"),
             size = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE, color = "#5A3E86") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_te), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres,
            aes(xmin = (start - 250000) / 1e6, xmax = (stop + 250000) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = "TE density") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/te_density.png",
       plot = te_dens_plot,
       width = 300, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```

## Add GC content
```{r}
genome <- readDNAStringSet("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/TAIR10_chr_all.fas")   # your FASTA path
names(genome) <- sub(" .*", "", names(genome))   # clean seq names -> "Chr1" etc.
# Calculate in existing windows  (same grid as pi_all)
gc_windows <- windows %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    gc = {
      chr_seq <- genome[[chromosome]]
      s <- max(1, window_start + 1)
      e <- min(length(chr_seq), window_end)
      sub <- subseq(chr_seq, start = s, end = e)
      f <- letterFrequency(sub, letters = c("G","C","A","T"))
      sum(f[c("G","C")]) / sum(f) * 100
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
gc <- gc_windows %>%
  dplyr::mutate(window_mid = (window_start + window_end) / 2) %>%   # if you have
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  mutate(med_gc = median(gc, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
library(tidyverse)

gc <- gc %>%
  left_join(centromeres, by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(
    region2 = case_when(
      window_start < start ~ "left",     # entirely left of centromere
      window_end > stop  ~ "right",    # entirely right of centromere
      TRUE                 ~ "centromere" # overlaps centromere
    )
  )

gc <- gc %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  mutate(med_gc = median(gc, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
gc <- ggplot(gc, aes(x = window_start / 1e6, y = gc)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = gc %>% filter(region2 != "centromere"),
              aes(ymin = med_gc, ymax = pmax(gc, med_gc), group = region2),
              fill = "#9E2A3A", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = gc %>% filter(region2 == "left"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, color = "#740A03", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = gc %>% filter(region2 == "right"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, color = "#740A03", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(data = gc %>% filter(region2 != "centromere"),
             size = 0.8, color = "#9E2A3A", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_gc), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres,
            aes(xmin = (start - 250000) / 1e6, xmax = (stop + 250000) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = "GC content") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/gc_content_500kb_windows.png",
       plot = gc,
       width = 300, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```

## Add expression pattern
```{r}
expression <- read.csv2('/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/expression_3_tissues/expression_3_tissues_orth_genes_500kb_not_sliding.csv',header=T, sep=";")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

expr <- expression %>%
  dplyr::rename(chromosome = chr_thal) %>%
  group_by(tissue, chromosome) %>%
  mutate(med_expr = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

tissue_cols <- c(F = "#1B9E77", P = "#D95F02", R = "#7570B3", S = "#E7298A")  # adjust to your tissues

library(dplyr)

# centromere midpoint per chromosome
cen_mid <- centromeres %>%
  mutate(chromosome = paste0("Chr", sub("Chr", "", chromosome)),  # ensure "Chr1" style
         cen_center = (start + stop) / 2) %>%
  dplyr::select(chromosome, start, stop, cen_center)

expr_R <- expr %>%
  filter(tissue == "R") %>%
  left_join(cen_mid, by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(region2 = case_when(
    window_start >= start & window_start <= stop ~ "centromere",
    window_start <  cen_center                   ~ "left",
    TRUE                                         ~ "right"
  ))



expr_plot <- ggplot(expr_R, aes(x = window_start / 1e6, y = expression)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = expr_R %>% filter(region2 != "centromere"),
              aes(ymin = med_expr, ymax = pmax(expression, med_expr), group = region2),
              fill = "#7570B3", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = expr_R %>% filter(region2 == "left"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, color = "#7570B3", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = expr_R %>% filter(region2 == "right"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, color = "#7570B3", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(data = expr_R %>% filter(region2 != "centromere"),
             size = 0.8, color = "#4A4680", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_expr), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres,
            aes(xmin = (start - 250000) / 1e6, xmax = (stop + 250000) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = "log2(counts+1) (rosette)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/expression_500kb_window_rosette.png",
       plot = expr_plot,
       width = 300, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```

## Add  Fst 
```{r}
fst <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/003_fst_27genomes/fst_thal_27g_tair10_based_fst.txt", header=T)

library(tidyverse)


# keep only windows that do NOT overlap a centromere
fst_nocen <- fst %>%
  left_join(centromeres, by = "chromosome") %>%
  filter(is.na(start) |                              # chroms without a centromere entry
         window_pos_2 < (start ) |           # window entirely left of centromere
         window_pos_1 > (stop  )) %>%         # window entirely right of centromere
  dplyr::select(names(fst))                                  # drop the joined centromere cols

fst <- fst %>%
  mutate(
    window_mid = (window_pos_1 + window_pos_2) / 2,
    fst_plot   = (avg_wc_fst),               # floor negatives at 0
    comparison = paste(pop1, pop2, sep = " vs ")
  )
fst <- fst[fst$pop1!=fst$pop2,]
library(tidyverse)

fst_nocen <- fst_nocen %>%
  left_join(centromeres, by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(
    arm = case_when(
      is.na(start)              ~ "whole",                    # no centromere entry
      window_pos_2 < start      ~ "left",
      window_pos_1 > stop       ~ "right",
      TRUE                      ~ NA_character_                # inside centromere (already
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(names(fst_nocen), arm)   # keep original cols + arm

fst <- ggplot(fst_nocen, aes(x = window_mid / 1e6, y = avg_wc_fst)) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres,
            aes(xmin = (start ) / 1e6, xmax = (stop ) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(color = "darkgrey", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = arm),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, se = FALSE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = expression(F[ST])) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")


ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/fst_500kb.png",
       plot = fst,
       width = 300, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```

# Make plot 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# rename centromere chrom col to match facet (~ Chr)
cen <- centromeres %>% dplyr::select(Chr = chromosome, start, stop)

crossover_data <- crossover_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(window_mid = (start + end) / 2) %>%
  left_join(cen, by = "Chr", suffix = c("", "_cen")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(arm = case_when(
    window_mid < start ~ "left",
    window_mid > stop  ~ "right",
    TRUE                   ~ "centromere")) %>%
  group_by(Chr) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(med_co = median(avg_co, na.rm = TRUE),
         above  = pmax(avg_co, med_co)) %>%
  ungroup()

crossover <- ggplot(crossover_data, aes(x = window_mid / 1e6, y = avg_co)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = crossover_data %>% filter(arm != "centromere"),
              aes(ymin = med_co, ymax = above, group = arm),
              fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_rect(data = cen,
            aes(xmin = start / 1e6, xmax = stop / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(color = "darkgrey", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = arm),
              method = "loess", span = 0.3, se = FALSE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_co), linetype = "dashed",
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Chr, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = "Crossover rate") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

crossover
```
